answers.A: C changed the route signature in 3 of 6 paired runs; route counts stayed 8 to 8. Customer assignment changes were 25, 23, and 15; directed arc symmetric differences were 68, 62, and 52 in the three changed pairs.
answers.B: C reduced system emissions in 4 of 6 pairs and increased them in 2 of 6. Operating cost was unchanged in 2, increased in 1, and decreased in 3. Customer and demand completion differences were zero in all 6 pairs.
answers.C: Two adverse pairs occurred: budget 100 seed 3 increased operating cost by 48.971413 CNY and system emissions by 24.501572 kg; budget 1000 seed 1 reduced operating cost by 16.048161 CNY but increased system emissions by 14.239578 kg.
answers.D: P changed the 48-slot charging distribution in 5 of 6 pairs. System emissions decreased in 2, were unchanged in 1, and increased in 3; midday energy increased in 2, was unchanged in 1, and decreased in 3.
answers.E: C had the larger signed emissions reduction in 5 of 6 pairs and P in 1 of 6; one of the five C-larger pairs had emissions increases under both arms. Per-pair cost deltas are retained in report.md and route_diff.csv.
